description: This file defines the 'DashboardLayout' React component which renders the main layout for an authenticated section of the frontend application. It includes UI elements such as Sidebar, Topbar, and nested route outlet with route change animations. The component manages layout state (collapsed/expanded) and handles route transition animations.

methods.name: DashboardLayout
methods.description: React functional component that renders the main application layout with route-based content and animations.
